svg.text: CM4 が network namespace owner、Simulator と Crane が follower。AppHost/DCP 管理面と Tracker.RuntimeHost データ面を分離。候補であり未実装・未検証。
Current host trial supports base only;
Candidate shared namespace — DCP support unresolved
Static endpoint alignment only — no packet acceptance
DCP sharing, ownership, multicast, and generation recreation unresolved.
Separate implemented selectable profiles — not running with current host trial
comparison: tigersmannheim/sumatra (TIGERs Sumatra), tracker-tigers, ER-Force tracker, DebugHost.
match: tigers-blue (TIGERs Sumatra), autoref-tigers (TIGERs AutoRef), SSL log recorder, match controller.
Host trial rejects non-base modes; do not imply comparison/match host RuntimeHost support.
Current PR #129 code still contains the C helper, .NET UDP boundary relay, and Crane launch overlay.
This drawing shows a proposed helper-free target; these removals and Windows communication are not implemented.
